run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the APPO actor-critic model on CPU or GPU with timing
test_forward_pass_cpu: test the APPO actor-critic model forward pass on CPU device

review_TestModel: review the TestModel class and its forward pass test methods for APPO model testing
